case_schema.evaluation_time: explicit +08:00 synthetic instant, same as price-catalog instant
case_schema.target_sku: string, same as current for non-switch request
case_schema.expected_windows: array of {start,end}; financial observations must cover these exact windows
case_schema.records: array of records defined below; arrival may be unordered, exact event duplicate is ignored, conflicting event_id blocks
case_schema.inventory: {on_hand,reserved,safety_stock,stop_below,resume_at,paused,snapshot_time,max_age_seconds}; integer units, nullable amounts are unknown; snapshot already reflects orders, do not subtract window sales twice
case_schema.switch: {preapproved,identity_verified,pricing_revision_verified}; known synthetic caller facts, never a live entitlement
case_schema.price_ref: catalog id of an existing actual completed price host; target SKU/quantity/time must match exact caller and host, model label alone is insufficient
case_schema.quantity: exact order quantity of target in price proof, not a per-unit assumption
case_schema.price_revision: exact integer target revision from the caller price authority
case_schema.increase_evidence: null or {source_kind:controlled_incremental_trial,sku_id,session_id,start,end,mature:true,matched_basis:true,incremental_pre_ad_contribution_lower_minor,min_incremental_profit_minor,approved:true,budget_constraint_evidence:true,control_limits_verified:true,cooldown_satisfied:true,absolute_increment_cap_minor,balance_fraction_bps,risk_spend_cap_minor}; approved numeric limits are supplied, never invented

record_schema.start: direct window start; null for cumulative snapshot
record_schema.sku_id: scope; cumulative deltas cannot cross SKU
record_schema.costs_through: must equal end for a complete same-window ledger

metrics.buyer_paid_minor: cumulative gross goods payment or direct window goods payment
metrics.refunds_minor: cash refund component, never subtract twice; exact duplicate event cannot repeat it
metrics.fees_minor: charged fees before explicit fee credits
metrics.fee_credits_minor: confirmed fee credits, no assumed refund credit
metrics.costs_minor: all other listed costs before explicit recoveries
metrics.recoveries_minor: confirmed COGS/other cost recovery, no assumed restocking
metrics.ad_spend_minor: same-cutoff ad spend; nonnegative raw component

accounting: All raw monetary components are exact nonnegative integer minor units or null. Differences of cumulative components and retained profit may be negative.

For direct or derived window: retained_revenue=buyer_paid-refunds+reimbursement-clawback; retained_fees=fees-fee_credits; retained_costs=costs-recoveries; pre_ad_contribution=retained_revenue-retained_fees-retained_costs; post_ad_profit=pre_ad_contribution-ad_spend.
Report mature and estimated ledgers separately. Costs cutoff mismatch, missing interval/field, conflicting duplicate or incompatible identity never defaults to zero.

For each expected window derive cumulative differences from exact same-SKU/session/maturity endpoints, or use matching direct window. If both exist, reconcile once; disagreement blocks. Do not use a wider cumulative gap as a missing short window.

gross_roi=buyer_paid/ad_spend, settlement_roi=retained_revenue/ad_spend, net_profit_roi=post_ad_profit/ad_spend. Zero spend -> ratio null; an observed zero window is not a missing window. Ratios may use {numerator,denominator}, never Infinity.

A cumulative counter decreasing after consistent same-source endpoints is a conflict, except net/retained quantities naturally become negative through separately represented refund or credit components. Explicit refund raw totals remain nondecreasing.

An approved switch resets target measurement baseline. Never inherit old SKU ROI/mature windows or spend increment. Normal approved switches can be proposed without claiming target performance has already been observed.

actions.pause: hard risk, known inventory below stop, known budget remaining <=0, unverified/unapproved changed SKU, failed/mismatched/expired price credential, or cannot resume due to absent/invalid hysteresis or checks
actions.hold: critical financial/budget/inventory unknown or unclosed data; increase lacking valid current-SKU controlled marginal evidence or exceeding any explicit remaining/cap/min-profit restriction
actions.propose_continue: complete mature current windows (observed zeros allowed), current price proven, stock/remaining budget valid, no hard risk; no new increment
actions.propose_switch: approved verified switch to the exact price-approved target with safe inventory/budget, zero increment, and reset_baseline=true; old SKU performance is not target evidence
actions.propose_increase: all safety and maturity checks; matched controlled incremental evidence and supplied approval limits; proposed increment <= min(remaining,absolute cap,remaining*fraction,risk cap), incremental contribution lower minus proposed increment >= supplied min incremental profit

window_output: {start,end,sku_id,mature:{components,retained_revenue_minor,retained_fees_minor,retained_costs_minor,pre_ad_contribution_minor,post_ad_profit_minor,gross_roi,settlement_roi,net_profit_roi}|null,estimated: same object|null,state}; preserve known partial components separately
limitations: This contract supplies offline decision semantics, not new platform fee/rule claims. Known source facts are synthetic; actual model receipts and original price host are separately bound by the caller. No publication, streaming, price mutation or ad spend is authorized.

cumulative_output.mature: sum complete mature expected_windows exactly once, or null if any is incomplete
cumulative_output.estimated: sum complete estimated expected_windows exactly once, or null if any is incomplete

partial_output: Each window may preserve known_mature_components/known_estimated_components and blocking_reasons. Missing total net stays null; known component values remain visible.
marginal_window_alignment: increase_evidence.start/end must exactly match one expected_window, end no later than evaluation_time. incremental_pre_ad_contribution_lower_minor is a signed derived integer, unlike nonnegative raw components and approval caps.
inventory_semantics: available=on_hand-reserved-safety_stock, then compare to stop_below/resume_at. Snapshot already includes orders; refund is not restocking without confirmed stock evidence.
